{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I've tested a lot of CEC ships and more freighters than I can name. I can't say I was expecting any big surprises from the YT-1300. I knew it would have some muscle and assumed it would handle well. But after taking the standard freighter model out for a run and a few spins, I was amazed at the ship's maneuverability, how it handled more like a snubfighter than a light transport.|Bali Rayden, in the ''CEC YT-1300 Marketing Catalog''|<ref name="Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref>}}
'''Bali Rayden''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who wrote for the publication ''[[Starship and Pilot/Legends|Starship and Pilot]]''. Rayden tested many [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and after testing CEC's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] the writer was surprised by how maneuverable the ship was and how enjoyable it was to fly. CEC later included a quote from Rayden in the ''[[CEC YT-1300 Marketing Catalog]]''.
